Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

PageNote.description:
One page a revision declares as changed (FR-REV-012).

`page` is not a link (`ew-model` lists it among the fields that are not links): a released revision
is immutable, so its notes keep naming a page that a later revision deletes, and a note on a page that
does not exist selects nothing.

oneOf.description: Panel builder (legal owner of the drawings).

RevisionState.description:
The stored state of a revision (doc 03 §4.2, doc 15 §5.1). "Signed off" is not a state: it is an open
revision whose sign-off matches the current content digest.

oneOf.description: The revision that collects the current edits; at most one (EW-INV-016).
Released: by `revision.release`, or historic (released before the project came to EW). Immutable.
A withdrawal record: it names the released revision it withdraws (`withdraws`, FR-REV-009).

SourceRef.description:
The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

key.description: The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`.

description:
One managed project revision (doc 03 §18, rank 60, `revisions.jsonl`; FR-REV-001).

The title block's "Revision" cell prints the current revision: the open one if there is one, else the
latest released one (D-05, FR-REV-003). A released revision is immutable (FR-REV-009); one without a
release record is historic (released outside EW, so it has no as-built archive and no page digests).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

author.description:
The author, as the role of a project party (doc 03 `Party`: form cells and revisions refer to
parties by role, FR-PRJ-003).

checker.description: The checker, as the role of a project party; never the author's role (D-34, FR-REV-005).

date.description: The revision date; an open revision may have none yet.

description.description: What the revision changes ("Changes on 101 and 106").

label.description: The label in the project's one format ("V2.0"; FR-REV-002).

page_notes.description:
The pages the revision declares as changed, each with an optional description (FR-REV-012), in
authored order, at most one note per page. They decide the changed pages of a release whose
predecessor has no page digests (doc 15 §5.6).

withdraws.description:
On a withdrawal record: the label of the released revision it withdraws (FR-REV-009). The withdrawn
record itself stays as it was (EW-INV-020); derivations leave it out.
